subject: Request for manual apportionment and evidence — unexpected postpay surge (June invoice)
messages:
From: Elena Rojas <elena@novametrics.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com, ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Cc: billing@novametrics.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Abrupt jump on June invoice — 06/10 charge spike (account: NovaMetrics)

Hi Chloe / Ben,

We just received our June invoice and there is a ~420% increase compared to our May consumption line for streaming token counts. The charge references an itemized window between 2027-06-10 and 2027-06-12. We do not have an internal release or campaign that could justify this.

Can you provide: 1) a per-request sample or export covering that window, 2) the routing/model variants used (we suspect an aux model was hit), and 3) guidance on how you calculate postpay apportionment for short bursts?

We are holding payment for the disputed invoice until we get evidence. Please treat this as urgent — tax & quarter close for us is next week.

Thanks,
Elena Rojas
VP Finance, NovaMetrics
elena@novametrics.com
Billing: billing@novametrics.com

From: chloe_martin@redwood-inference.com
To: Elena Rojas <elena@novametrics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 17:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Abrupt jump on June invoice — 06/10 charge spike (account: NovaMetrics)

Hi Elena — thanks for flagging this and sorry for the disruption. I'm putting Ben and Marissa on the thread to pull detailed usage extracts and a short root-cause note.

What we'll do immediately:
- Produce a per-request export for 2027-06-10 00:00 to 2027-06-12 23:59 (CSV with request_id, model_variant, route, tokens_in, tokens_out).
- Surface routing logs and model fallback events for that window.
- Propose a provisional credit if we confirm a platform-side attribution (e.g., misrouted staging traffic or misattributed API keys).

Ben / Marissa — can billing ops generate the CSV and a short delta analysis (expected vs observed), and confirm whether any aux-model routing or sampling change was deployed in the region (us-east-1) over that period?

Elena — we'll aim to get the export and a first pass analysis by EOD tomorrow (Fri). If you can share the HubSpot invoice id or your internal invoice reference, that helps us match ledgers.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Lead — Customer Success
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
To: chloe_martin@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Abrupt jump on June invoice — 06/10 charge spike (account: NovaMetrics)

Chloe / Marissa — billing ops started the export and I pulled a sampling query from the production aggregator. Preliminary observations:
- CSV (being prepared) will include ~72k request rows for 2027-06-10—06-12.
- A concentrated burst (~58% of incremental tokens) is tied to the API key ending in -nm-prod-4 used by NovaMetrics' ingest pipeline.
- There are ~3.7k requests that show fallback to the aux-text-compact model for requests < 512 tokens — likely due to a transient capacity routing issue that caused retries within 60s.

My ask: Marissa, can you confirm if any autoscaler config change or kernel rollout in us-east-1 happened around 2027-06-09 22:00 UTC? If a platform-side routing fallback was responsible, recommend offering a provisional credit while we finish the CSV.

I'll attach the first CSV snapshot and a short log excerpt once billing ops finishes.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com

Attachment: usage_export_snapshot1.csv (preliminary)

From: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
To: chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com, ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Abrupt jump on June invoice — 06/10 charge spike (account: NovaMetrics)

Chloe / Ben / Elena — billing ops complete: attaching two artifacts and a short findings note.

Attachments:
- usage_export_20270610-06-12.csv (72,183 rows)
- sample-telemetry-20270612.gz (100MB gz of routing logs)

Findings (summary):
1) Attribution: 91% of the incremental token volume is from API key suffix -nm-prod-4 between 2027-06-10T05:12:13Z and 2027-06-11T02:47:20Z. The key maps to NovaMetrics' production ingest pipeline.
2) Routing fallbacks: There was a transient kernel rollout candidate in us-east-1 at 2027-06-09T22:18:00Z that caused a brief autoscaler backoff in 3 pods; the runtime routed ~3.7k requests to aux-text-compact (lower-cost model) but several requests retried and re-ingested, causing duplicate token counts for a subset (~2.1k requests) where retries were recorded as separate successful requests. That duplication accounts for ~41% of the incremental tokens.
3) Postpay apportionment: our standard is to bill actual successful requests (de-duplicated by request_id when clearly retried within the same 60s window). In this case a subset of retries were not deduplicated due to missing retry headers from the client.

Proposed remediation:
- Offer a provisional credit of $18,450 (computed from duplicated token count) pending a deeper telemetry reconciliation.
- Run a targeted de-dup job using NovaMetrics' request_id pattern (you provided a sample id in the HubSpot comment) and update ledger entries within 7 business days.
- If NovaMetrics runs a short internal dedupe and provides a list of canonical request_ids, we can finalize sooner.

Elena — we can create a revised invoice and apply the provisional credit immediately so you can release payment against net balance.

Marissa Cole
Billing Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: usage_export_20270610-06-12.csv, sample-telemetry-20270612.gz

From: Elena Rojas <elena@novametrics.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Cc: billing@novametrics.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Abrupt jump on June invoice — 06/10 charge spike (account: NovaMetrics)

Chloe / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the detail. The CSV lines up with what we see on our side for the -nm-prod-4 key.

We accept the provisional credit of $18,450 and will run our de-dup script this afternoon to produce a canonical-request_id list. Can you confirm the exact ledger delta that will appear on the revised invoice (line items and VAT treatment)? We need a PDF invoice for our AP team showing the credit and the new net amount (VAT: 8.5% — our jurisdiction requires tax on the net charge).

Also please call out the timeframe for final reconciliation (your note says 7 business days). We'll keep the payment on hold until the revised invoice is generated.

Thanks,
Elena
VP Finance, NovaMetrics
